newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan to lead Hertz IPO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan to lead Hertz IPO - WSJ.

text.p: Ford Motor Co is expected to name J.P. Morgan the lead underwriter for the initial public offering of Hertz Corp as early as this week, the Wall Street Journal said in its Wednesday electronic edition.
The report said that in a number of recent merger and acquisition assignments, Ford has favored J.P. Morgan over Goldman Sachs & Co, which helped take Ford public 40 years ago.

J.P. Morgan advised Ford on the $1.7 billion sale of its Budget Rent-A-Car division, and last year it was Ford's lead advisor on a series of merger-and-acquisition assignments valued at $6.4 billion, the report said.
Goldman and Ford officials told the paper their relationship remains strong.
"We wanted to go to the dance with Goldman Sachs, but we wanted to dance with other people," Bill Blood, the recently retired treasurer of Ford's Financial Services Group, told the paper.
